title: Harvesting Harmony: Reiki & Restorative Sound Bath Journey
description: Gift yourself the opportunity to unwind and restore before the holiday season come! Personal Reiki session during sound bathing (2hrs)
long_description:
Gift yourself the opportunity to unwind and restore before the holiday season come! Personal Reiki session during sound bathing (2hrs)

About this Event

Immersive soundscape for 2 hours with indiviual personal 15-minute Reiki session, all before the holiday season and a perfect way to unwind and restore!
Sunday Nov 15th from 2-4pm
At Steel Goat Marketplace-Penn Hills

Join Erin Scherer of Lifted Spiritss and Reiki Master Dana Acuri for an afternoon of divine bliss! We will center in first with some hot tea, a short teaching of reiki and sound healing, and what to expect. You will then relax into the cosmos for the remainder of the time for an immersive soundscape by Erin and experience with crystal bowls, shamanic drum, wind gong, chimes, ocarania flute and more sound instruments. 
Each participant will be pulled for a 15 minute personal reiki session by Dana with reiki table, blanket and comfort items at your aid. 
This offering is limited to 7 participants. If you are new to reiki or sound bathing and have any questions or concerns, please reach out!
$70 per person-tea and motivational/spiritual goodie bag included 

A little info on these ladies:
Erin is a certified 200hr yoga instructor, sound practitioner, meditation facilitator, somatic guide, oddities artist, self published author, and runs a pet service business, with a previous career in the veterinary field. Whether it's animals or people she is working with, every soul is family and an honor to uplift their spirits!

Dana is a captivating Author, Speaker, Certified Master Energy Practitioner, Evidential Medium/Psychic, and a Facilitator of Sacred Sister’s Healing Circle. Her background entails facilitating women’s spiritual groups, teaching therapeutic workshops, Intuitive Coaching, and working as a Certified Trauma Recovery Coach in the mental health industry, Reiki healing and with Quantum Energy Healing.
